column2: a travelling peddler carrying a tall wooden A-frame backpack loaded with goods, grinning slyly and holding out a hand
a mysterious old man with a long white beard and a walking staff standing on a misty path under a blossoming plum tree, smiling knowingly as if he has met you many times
a nameless grave mound in tall windswept grass with a rusty sword stuck into it, a few crows
a young apprentice blacksmith at a small village forge, anvil and hammer, glowing coals, looking eager to show his skill
a caravan of a martial escort agency, carts piled with cargo pulled along a narrow mountain road, guards with spears and a plain flag, glancing warily up at the cliffs
a collapsed cave training hall, sword stance figures carved into the rock wall, a shaft of light falling through a crack in the ceiling
a ruined mountain spirit shrine with a collapsed tiled roof, an incense burner and offerings of fruit and rice cakes still on the altar, a faded painting of an old mountain god with a tiger
cultists in dark hooded robes dragging a bound young martial artist along a forest path at dusk
a shady gambler in the corner of a dim roadside tavern shuffling long narrow gambling cards on a low table, an oil lamp, scattered coins and a wine jug
an abandoned old apothecary interior, a dusty wooden medicine cabinet with many small drawers, unlabeled ceramic medicine bottles on the shelves, pale light through a torn paper window
an old wandering physician with a wooden medicine chest on his back, sitting by a mountain roadside under a pine tree, herb bundles and small medicine bottles laid out on a cloth before him

an old rusted wooden donation box with a corroded iron padlock sitting alone before the collapsed steps of a ruined Buddhist temple hall, broken roof tiles and weeds around it, a few old coins glinting through the slot

a dim small penance room inside a ruined mountain temple, a single straw meditation cushion on the wooden floor facing a paper screen, the faint silhouette of an old monk behind the screen lit by one candle, incense smoke drifting

a wooden fish drum (mokeo) carved like a carp hanging from the eaves of an empty ruined temple corridor, the striking mallet resting beside it, mist drifting through broken lattice doors, no one in sight

Inside a small quiet village ancestral shrine, an old thick ledger book lies open on a low wooden altar, around it relics of fallen heroes: a chipped sword, a jade pendant, a worn gourd, a folded martial arts manual, incense smoke, candlelight, memorial tablets in the dim background

A dark village shrine at night, an ominous old ledger of karma lies open on the altar, its pages soaked with seeping blood-red ink, above it a row of six hanging paper lanterns, some glowing deep blood red while the others are still dark, incense smoke drifting, heavy foreboding atmosphere
an old dusty library hall, tall wooden shelves crammed with bamboo scrolls and martial arts manuals, one ancient scroll unrolled on a reading desk under a shaft of light, dust floating

a defeated swordsman in pale green robes kneeling on one knee in a misty bamboo grove, his long sword planted in the ground beside him, holding out an old sword manual scroll with a calm resigned face, cut bamboo leaves drifting

a huge burly bearded martial artist with heavy iron gauntlets sitting heavily on the ground before a broken stone gate, his fists lowered on his knees, laughing at his own defeat, cracked stones around him

a fallen renegade buddhist monk with a scarred shaved head kneeling in a ruined temple courtyard, his heavy monk staff with metal rings laid on the ground before him, head bowed, fallen prayer beads, broken lanterns

a weathered river swordsman in a straw rain cape standing knee deep in a wide murky river by a wooden water fortress, planting his sword point down into the water, ripples spreading, calm defeated expression
a gaunt swordsman in black robes kneeling inside a dark ancient tomb hall, his blood red shadow afterimages fading away from him like smoke, his thin blade lying on the stone floor, dim red light
